newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein stable, trade quiet.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein stable, trade quiet.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were stable in late trading on Friday, with buying interest remaining thin, traders said.
They said palm olein was quoted at 1,445-50 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, unchanged from the opening. Crude palm oil was last done at around 1,252 rupiah/kg in Medan.
"The market was rather slow," one trader said. "Buyers were mostly sidelined or looking for lower prices."
The traders said buyers wanted to keep their stocks low as a precaution against possible social unrest during the campaign period for the general election on May 29.
